headline: 7.1-magnitude quake: Japan's Kumamoto prefecture hit by powerful earthquake
summary: A massive earthquake has caused power outages, road ruptures, and building collapses, leaving several dead and many others trapped.
details: A 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Japan's southern Kumamoto prefecture, causing widespread destruction. The quake led to power outages for thousands of homes, ruptured roads, and the partial collapse of a shopping mall.

headline_marked: 26 of 34 toothpaste samples [[contain microplastics]], HC orders probe
headline: 26 of 34 toothpaste samples contain microplastics, HC orders probe
summary: The High Court has ordered an expert committee to investigate after a study found plastic particles in 19 major toothpaste brands.
details: The High Court has ordered the government to form a a three-member expert committee, led by a BUET teacher, to investigate the presence of microplastics in toothpaste samples tested in Bangladesh.

The order follows a public interest writ petition citing a study by the Environment and Social Development Organization (ESDO), which found microplastics in 26 of 34 samples from 19 major brands from Bangladesh, India, Thailand, and Vietnam.
The committee is required to submit its findings and report within 15 days.
The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution (BSTI) has stated it will independently test samples from the market and manufacturing facilities to verify the findings.
BSTI noted that while current toothpaste standards in Bangladesh do not explicitly prohibit microplastics, they are not on the list of 81 permitted ingredients.
The agency cautioned that detecting plastic particles does not automatically prove that manufacturers intentionally added them or that the products pose an immediate health risk.
BSTI has urged the public not to panic and advised consumers to maintain regular oral hygiene and avoid swallowing toothpaste while awaiting verified scientific information.
caption:
Microplastics found in 26 of 34 toothpaste samples. The High Court has stepped in to order an urgent probe.

The High Court has ordered the government to form a a three-member expert committee, led by a BUET teacher, to investigate the presence of microplastics in toothpaste samples tested in Bangladesh.

The order follows a public interest writ petition citing a study by the Environment and Social Development Organization (ESDO), which found microplastics in 26 of 34 samples from 19 major brands from Bangladesh, India, Thailand, and Vietnam.

The committee is required to submit its findings and report within 15 days.

The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution (BSTI) has stated it will independently test samples from the market and manufacturing facilities to verify the findings.

BSTI noted that while current toothpaste standards in Bangladesh do not explicitly prohibit microplastics, they are not on the list of 81 permitted ingredients.

The agency cautioned that detecting plastic particles does not automatically prove that manufacturers intentionally added them or that the products pose an immediate health risk.

BSTI has urged the public not to panic and advised consumers to maintain regular oral hygiene and avoid swallowing toothpaste while awaiting verified scientific information.

Source: The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
